about: GENERATED by scripts/mobile/vectors.ts from packages/core/fixtures/inbox-relay-push-v2-vectors.json. Do not edit. The push suite is the Inbox's own push vectors, in the file named in "vectors": each push's plaintext, its sealed envelope and size, and its collapse id, under the all-zero pairing. The app opens each envelope with "key", reads the plaintext, and derives the same collapse id from "collapse_key".
